source_metadata.title: Comprehensive Long-Term Changes in Cardiovascular Risk Biomarkers With Tirzepatide: A SURMOUNT-1 Post Hoc Analysis
source_metadata.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology (JACC)
source_metadata.source_type: Original research; post hoc biomarker analysis of the phase 3 SURMOUNT-1 randomized trial

extraction_limitations: The analysis is post hoc and selected treatment completers, so atoms describe the reported biomarker analysis rather than an intention-to-treat clinical-outcomes analysis.

Analysis denominators vary by biomarker because MMRM inclusion required nonmissing baseline and at least one postbaseline value; result atoms intentionally do not assign a single denominator where the exact cell-specific N was not reported in the main figure.
The parent SURMOUNT-1 protocol and SAP were reviewed as context for the randomized trial but were not treated as primary evidence for post hoc biomarker results.
No adverse-event atoms were created because the evaluated article is a biomarker analysis and does not report treatment-emergent safety outcomes as study results.
Correlation atoms retain associations only; no mediator or causal-mechanism inference was encoded as reported data.
